name: The Malkin Tower Coven
summary: The site of one of the most famous alleged coven gatherings in English history, set against the moody backdrop of Pendle Hill.
lore: On Good Friday in 1612, a group gathered at Malkin Tower, the home of Elizabeth Southerns ('Old Demdike'). Two rival families of folk healers and cunning folk had assembled for a feast. Local magistrate Roger Nowell claimed it was a secret coven plotting to blow up Lancaster Castle and free imprisoned matriarchs. The meeting triggered the notorious Pendle Witch Trials, resulting in ten executions and shaping the archetype of the English witch.

events.title: The Good Friday Gathering
events.narrative: It is Good Friday. The families gather at Malkin Tower for the feast — but this year, Roger Nowell's men are said to be watching the roads.

choiceA.label: Hold the gathering anyway
choiceA.description: +150 Faith if undiscovered, −6 Followers if raided

random.winMessage: The gathering passes undisturbed. The families leave strengthened and loyal. +150 Faith.
random.lossMessage: Nowell's men raid the tower. Six of your number are taken in chains. −6 Followers.

choiceB.label: Scatter the gathering and meet in secret

events.title: The Burnley Moor-Witches Move In
events.narrative: The cunning-folk of Burnley have been selling charms at your market stalls and hexing any who refuse them. They claim the Pendle slopes are theirs now.

choiceA.label: Outshine them with a public rite on the hill

events.title: The Colne Familiar-Binders
events.narrative: Word comes from Colne: the hedge-witches there have bound a new familiar — a great black dog that frightens cattle and children alike. They dare you to match them.

choiceA.label: Bind your own familiar in answer

events.title: The Clitheroe Alchemists' Offer
events.narrative: The castle-town alchemists of Clitheroe send a sealed letter: they have refined a lead-to-gold process and will share it — for a contribution to their work.

choiceA.label: Fund their work
choiceA.description: +150 Gold if it succeeds, −60 Gold if it fails

random.winMessage: The transmutation holds. You receive a share of true gold. +150 Gold.
random.lossMessage: The process collapses in smoke and lead. You lose your investment. −60 Gold.

events.title: Old Demdike's Vision
events.narrative: Old Demdike wakes from a fever-dream, wild-eyed. She swears she saw Lancaster Castle in flames and your matriarchs walking free. The coven buzzes with hope.

choiceA.label: Prophesy the vision to the coven

choiceB.label: Act on it and plan a liberation

events.title: Nowell's Spy Among You
events.narrative: A young woman in the coven is seen slipping notes to a stranger in Colne. You suspect she carries words to Roger Nowell, the magistrate.

choiceA.label: Confront her before the coven
choiceA.description: +100 Faith if loyal, −5 Followers if she flees

random.winMessage: She breaks down and confesses. The coven binds her to silence, and your standing rises. +100 Faith.
random.lossMessage: She flees in the night to Nowell, carrying names. Five followers must scatter. −5 Followers.

events.title: The Black Dog of Pendle
events.narrative: A huge black dog is seen on the moor at dusk, eyes like embers. The villagers say it is a familiar gone rogue, killing sheep and stalking the lonely roads.

events.title: The Lancaster Castle Plot
events.narrative: A plan is whispered among the families: blow open Lancaster Castle's gates with gunpowder and free the imprisoned matriarchs. It is bold and desperate.

choiceA.label: Back the plot
choiceA.description: +8 Followers if it works, −6 Followers if betrayed

random.winMessage: The gates blow open. The matriarchs walk free into the night, and the coven swells with the rescued. +8 Followers.
random.lossMessage: The plot is betrayed to Nowell. Six of your number are seized before they can flee. −6 Followers.

events.title: The Charm Market Booms
events.narrative: Your cunning-folk have cornered the charm trade at Colne market. Cures, hexes, and love-charms sell faster than you can make them. Coin flows in.

choiceA.label: Reinvest the profits in the coven

events.title: A Wandering Healer Seeks Shelter
events.narrative: A gaunt man with a satchel of herbs arrives at Malkin Tower, soaked from the moor rain. 'I have walked from York. I can heal any ailment but my own loneliness. I seek a people.'

choiceB.label: Buy his herbs and send him on
